A priest of the ancient Jerusalem Temple, about 35 years old, short dark beard, BAREFOOT, wearing a long-sleeved white linen tunic down to the ankles, a white linen sash wound twice around the waist and a small cone-shaped white linen cap; the head and both ears are fully covered, no sidelocks, no hair visible below the cap. Pose: he carries a large round flat woven basket piled with flour offerings on top of his head, both arms raised and both hands holding the basket from the sides.
